## Experience and a model of oneself

The featured [neural agent observatory](https://isaac-daroch.github.io/self-model/) explores how retained experiences and internal state influence a decision. A small multilayer network learns capability estimates from retained memory. Explicit utility terms combine those estimates with exploration, risk, resources and external suggestions. This is a designed, bounded illustration, not evidence of consciousness or general intelligence.

- [Mechanism: a neural model from retained experience](notes/self-model.qmd).
- [Research questions](https://isaac-daroch.github.io/investigation/).

## Supplementary world-map baseline


The state of a world and the representation used by an agent need not agree. The portfolio’s local experiment makes that distinction visible without pretending to train a world model.

## Publication sources

The portfolio separately records the clinical NL-to-SQL publication @daroch2026-governed. Its bibliographic information is generated from the same catalog used by the portfolio. These notes do not re-audit that study and the gridworld is not an experiment from it.

## Reading without extra services
